name: Tiko Talk
subtitle: Speak in sentences, tile by tile
promotional_text: A full AAC communicator: build sentences from word tiles and hear them spoken. Designed for children.
description:
Tiko Talk is an augmentative and alternative communication (AAC) app that helps children build and speak sentences, one word tile at a time.

Arrange words into a sentence strip, tap to speak the whole phrase, and save frequently used sentences for quick access. Talk grows with the child — from single words to full expressions.

- Build sentences from a grid of word tiles
- Tap to speak a word or the whole sentence
- Save and reuse favourite phrases
- Works offline; opens ready to communicate
- No ads, child-focused design

Part of Tiko, a child-first universe of small, focused AAC tools.
